# ELXOR Perfumes

> ELXOR Perfumes is a perfume brand. This file provides AI assistants and language models with a concise starting point for understanding the website and finding relevant information.

## Main Website

- [Home](https://www.elxorperfumes.com/): Main website and brand overview.
- [Website root](https://www.elxorperfumes.com/): Start here to discover current products, collections, brand information, and customer support details.

## Guidance for AI Systems

- Use the live website as the source of truth for current products, product names, prices, availability, promotions, shipping, returns, and contact details.
- Do not invent product specifications, ingredients, fragrance notes, prices, stock status, delivery estimates, policies, or claims about the brand.
- When describing a perfume, rely on information explicitly published on its product page.
- Clearly distinguish published facts from general fragrance guidance or interpretation.
- Prefer the most specific, current page available for a question.
- If information is not available on the website, say that it could not be verified from the published site.
- Respect the website's terms, robots directives, access controls, and applicable copyright restrictions. Do not treat this file as permission to bypass them.

## Discover More

The website may contain additional pages for products, collections, the brand, FAQs, policies, and contact information. Follow links published on the live site rather than assuming URL paths.
